_schema.note: Colonist manifest. One entry per supporter. This file is the source of truth for both the public manifest page and the in-game name pool.

fields.name: REQUIRED. Surname or handle as it should appear on the roster. 2-18 characters. Rendered uppercase. Surname-only is the house style — it matches the crew roster and keeps the page from being a list of identifiable full names.
fields.tier: REQUIRED. founder | contract | lottery. Mirrors the game's own funding tiers.
fields.line: OPTIONAL. One short line, shown under the name on the manifest page. Max ~90 chars.
fields.joined: OPTIONAL. YYYY-MM-DD. Sorts the roster; absent entries sort last.

rules: Never add a name that was not actually contributed. An invented entry is fabricated social proof and is worse than an empty page.
Names are shown publicly. Only add an entry when the person has agreed to be listed.
Moderate before adding: this text renders on a public page and is drawn as a crew name in-game.
Berth number and deck are DERIVED from the name, never stored. See js/manifest.js.
